parent_objective: design sentinel-filtered v4 sequence-outcome corpus export after M752 positive diagnostic

public_gates: M754 filters sentinel rows from M752 outcome positives
M754 preserves v4-specific source and claim-boundary metadata
M754 defines positive normal hard-negative and sentinel row roles
objective training PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export sentinel rows as positives
do not export action-only rows as outcome positives
do not drop v4 source metadata
do not overclaim current proxy faults as true four-wheel physics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs sentinel-filtered v4-aware corpus export from M752 positive rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training objective or checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if sentinel rows cannot be filtered
stop if v4 source metadata would be dropped
stop if action-only rows are mixed into positive corpus
stop if the design admits PPO or promotion
fallback_plan: if corpus diversity fails, design repeat sequence validation with refreshed v4 source rows
if sentinel filtering removes too much evidence, design stricter sentinel-filtered sequence rerun
if corpus is clean, implement export before objective design
if claim boundary is insufficient, pivot to four-wheel/high-fidelity simulator planning
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M753 promotes v4 sequence positive diagnostic to corpus export branch

hypothesis: M752's non-sentinel v4 sequence-outcome rows can be exported as a compact diverse corpus while preserving v4 source and claim-boundary metadata.
success_criteria: M754 defines positive and contrast row selection
M754 defines v4 metadata preservation requirements
M754 defines diversity and sentinel gates
M754 defines export artifacts and command
M754 blocks objective training PPO and promotion
M754 admits only a no-training M755 implementation
failure_criteria: design exports sentinel rows as positives
design treats action-only rows as outcome positives
design drops v4 source or claim-boundary metadata
design admits PPO or checkpoint promotion
decision_rule: M754 may only design a no-training v4 corpus export. It must not admit sequence objective training PPO or promotion until the exported corpus is implemented and audited.
